newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran police seize one tonne of opium in shootout.
newsitem.headline: Iran police seize one tonne of opium in shootout.

text.p: Police in northeastern Iran seized one tonne (2,200 lb) of opium after a deadly shootout with drug smugglers, the official news agency IRNA said on Sunday.
It said law enforcement personnel had seized the drugs in Torbat-e-Jam late on Saturday.
"One of the smugglers was killed and some ammunition confiscated by the local forces," IRNA said.

According to Iranian law, possession of five kg (11 lb) of opium or 30 grams (just over one ounce) of heroin is punishable by death. More than 1,000 people have been executed in drug-related cases since the law took effect in 1989.
Iran is a key transit route for drugs, mostly opium from which heroin is made, being smuggled to Europe via Turkey from Afghanistan and Pakistan.
